title: Explore
text: Meet ExerxEye, a modern fitness tracker built around a simple flow: explore, train, and track. Browse a structured exercise library with a clean interface and a true dark mode.

title: Exercise intelligence
text: Open any movement for focused exercise details, training context, related movements, and your own recent history. ExerxEye keeps discovery connected to the way you actually train.

title: Training home
text: Create a local profile with only a username and password. Your training home brings today's plan, weekly goal, recent activity, streaks, and strength markers into one organized view.

title: Workout generator
text: Build plans manually, or generate a workout in seconds. Choose full body, upper, lower, push, pull, or a single muscle focus, then edit the generated plan before you train.

title: Weekly planner
text: The weekly planner maps saved workouts across Monday through Sunday. Your scheduled session then surfaces automatically on Home when that training day arrives.

title: Progress analytics
text: Track completed sets, volume, estimated one rep max markers, repetitions in reserve, and workout history across seven, thirty, ninety, or three hundred sixty five day views.

title: Private exports
text: Your data stays organized by account, and the export center can download progress, workouts, favorites, the exercise library, or a complete account bundle in CSV and JSON formats.

title: ExerxEye
text: ExerxEye combines exercise discovery, workout planning, training sessions, analytics, exports, dark mode, and installable PWA support in one Flask application. ExerxEye. Exercise intelligence and analytics for your training.
